preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of drawings k must be exactly 2.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating whether the Tree of Life can be recovered.
If the output is 'YES', the number of edges in the output must be exactly n - 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in output_edges)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', all edges must connect valid node indices between 1 and n.
